decisionLog.designQuestion: The selected input P&ID includes P-4713, H-1009, Feed Tank, Reactor Feed. What fluid/material basis should the refinement branch use first?
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Start the branching refinement from the selected input P&ID rather than a generic template.

decisionLog.designQuestion: The current fluid basis is Clean water. What design flow rate should size the main process-line branch?
decisionLog.affectedComponent: main line size, pump capacity, and flow instrument range
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Use the fluid decision to make the next sizing question more contextual.

decisionLog.designQuestion: The current line basis is DN50. What pressure-duty detail should be attached to the pump/equipment branch already present in the selected P&ID?
decisionLog.decision: A) Transfer pump, delta P approximately 3 bar
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Ask pressure duty only after a flow basis exists, because the pump/protection branch depends on both.

decisionLog.designQuestion: The current pump basis is Transfer pump; delta P approx. 3 bar. What downstream treatment configuration should update the existing heat-exchanger branch?
decisionLog.decision: A) Direct treatment without heat exchanger
decisionLog.affectedComponent: heat exchanger, bypass valves, and treatment train
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Make the treatment question depend on whether the selected input P&ID already contains heat-transfer equipment.

decisionLog.designQuestion: The graph now has branches for process fluid, flow rate, pressure duty, treatment configuration. Should the system generate a reviewable P&ID candidate now?
decisionLog.communicationPurpose: Use the visible branch history as the basis for the human review gate.
